name: seo-content-machine
description: Plan SEO pages in an SEO Workspace and have the SEO Content Machine desktop app research, write and review each one as a draft, from a list of keywords or a local business's services and towns. Needs SEO Content Machine running on the same machine (paid app, 14-day free trial).

api_key.title: SCM API key
api_key.description: Only if you set one in SCM under Settings > App > Api secret key. Leave blank otherwise.

api_url.title: SCM API address
api_url.description: Where SCM's API listens. Leave the default unless you changed SCM's port.
